description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

Tries to request a reverse of a previous Pull Transaction.
 Note: Delete Transaction is NOT eligible to be used for an <<glossary:ACH>> Transaction.

query.description:
Use for reversing a transaction. (i.e. if Delete Transaction Request is *after* settlement of original *pull* transaction.)

Required to use `void` or `reversal` on every pull transaction DELETE request (non RTP).

Request to enable [Multiple Reversals](/docs/multiple-reversals#/) at [TabaPay Support](https://tabapay.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new#/) or [help@tabapay.com](mailto:help@tabapay.com)

Use for voiding a transaction. (i.e. if Delete Transaction request is *before* settlement of original *pull* transaction.)

**Note**: When reversing a transaction with status: `AUTHOIRZED`, you must use the `?void` parameter. Required to use `void` or `reversal` on every pull transaction DELETE request (non RTP).

If using`?request`: Requests a return of a previously sent RTP push transaction.
If using `?response`: Responds to a request of a previously received Request for Return of Funds (for a previously received RTP transaction).

query.description:
Use if you are sending a Request for Return of Funds (regarding the original RTP-Credit Transfer).

Must use `request` or `response`

Use if you are responding to a Request for Return of Funds (regarding a received RTP-Credit Transfer).

*Must use `response` or `request`*
